instruction: Would you mind starting this video stream for me? https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_4x3/gear1/prog_index.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_4x3 gear1 variant). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_vlc_playing_info' correctly extracts VLC playing status via HTTP interface (status.xml)
Metric 'is_vlc_playing' comprehensively checks both VLC state ('playing') and URL matching
Metric has specialized logic for HLS streams with filename fallback matching (vlc.py:107-114), which handles cases where VLC shows just 'prog_index.m3u8' instead of the full URL
Complete coverage: Instruction requires starting the specific stream URL, evaluator verifies both playing state and URL match
Expected URL value is correct and matches the instruction exactly
Robust error handling with multiple fallback XML paths for URL extraction (vlc.py:75-94)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts state → metric parses XML and compares → returns 1.0 if playing and URL matches
